title: Infectious Diseases & Antimicrobial Resistance
blurb: Pathogen genomes, surveillance line lists, AMR, tuberculosis, malaria, influenza and historical notifiable-disease data.

items.name: WHO Global Tuberculosis Data
items.description: Country-reported TB notifications, treatment outcomes, drug resistance, TB/HIV, financing and WHO incidence estimates since 2000.

items.name: WHO FluNet
items.description: Weekly virological surveillance data on influenza (and SARS-CoV-2/RSV) from national influenza centres in 150+ countries since 1995.

items.name: Malaria Atlas Project
items.description: Geospatial estimates of malaria prevalence, incidence and intervention coverage plus parasite-rate and vector-occurrence surveys, with an R package.

items.name: WHO GLASS
items.full_name: Global Antimicrobial Resistance and Use Surveillance System
items.description: Country-reported surveillance data on resistance in priority bacterial pathogens and antimicrobial consumption, with an interactive dashboard.

items.name: ResistanceMap
items.description: Interactive maps and trends of antibiotic resistance and antibiotic consumption for countries worldwide, including the Drug Resistance Index.

items.name: Vivli AMR Register
items.description: Industry AMR surveillance datasets (e.g. Pfizer ATLAS, GSK SOAR, J&J, Paratek) with millions of isolate-level susceptibility results.
items.access_note: Free; registration and data request reviewed by the contributor.

items.name: BV-BRC
items.full_name: Bacterial and Viral Bioinformatics Resource Center
items.description: Integrated genomes, AMR phenotypes, protein families and analysis tools for bacterial and viral pathogens (merger of PATRIC, IRD and ViPR).
items.access_note: Open; free account to run analysis services.

paper.label: Olson RD et al. Nucleic Acids Res 2023;51:D678

items.name: NCBI Pathogen Detection
items.description: Real-time clustering of bacterial and fungal pathogen genomes from food, environment and patients, with AMR gene calls (AMRFinderPlus).

items.name: NCBI Virus
items.description: Portal for searching and downloading viral sequences (incl. SARS-CoV-2, influenza, dengue, mpox) with metadata.

items.name: GISAID
items.description: Global initiative sharing influenza, SARS-CoV-2, RSV, mpox and other virus genomes with associated epidemiological metadata.
items.access_note: Free; registration with identity verification and acceptance of the Database Access Agreement.

paper.label: Shu Y, McCauley J. Euro Surveill 2017;22:30494

items.name: Nextstrain
items.description: Real-time phylogenetic tracking of pathogen evolution (SARS-CoV-2, influenza, mpox, dengue, measles…) with open curated datasets and tools.

items.name: Project Tycho
items.description: Digitised US notifiable-disease reports since 1888 and global disease counts standardised for research on historical epidemics and vaccination impact.

paper.label: van Panhuis WG et al. N Engl J Med 2013;369:2152

items.name: Delphi Epidata (COVIDcast)
items.description: API of real-time US epidemic indicators — cases, hospitalisations, claims, symptom surveys, influenza-like illness — from Carnegie Mellon's Delphi group.

items.name: JHU CSSE COVID-19 Data (archived)
items.description: The iconic global daily COVID-19 case and death time series (Jan 2020–Mar 2023) that powered the Johns Hopkins dashboard.
items.access_note: Direct download from GitHub (CC BY 4.0); no longer updated.

paper.label: Dong E et al. Lancet Infect Dis 2020;20:533

items.name: ECDC Surveillance Atlas of Infectious Diseases
items.description: Interactive EU/EEA surveillance data for ~50 communicable diseases including AMR (EARS-Net), with downloadable tables.
items.provider: European Centre for Disease Prevention and Control

items.name: Global.health
items.description: Open, de-identified line-list case data for outbreaks (COVID-19, mpox, Marburg, H5N1) curated from public sources.
items.access_note: Open download (some datasets require free login).
